orders_pipe.name: ORDERS_PIPE
orders_pipe.copy_statement: COPY INTO ICEBERG_DB.RAW_DATA.ORDERS_DATA (order_id, customer_id, order_date, product, quantity, unit_price, region, source_file, load_timestamp) FROM (SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, METADATA$FILENAME, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() FROM @ICEBERG_DB.UTIL.S3_EXTERNAL_STAGE_CSV) FILE_FORMAT = (FORMAT_NAME = 'ICEBERG_DB.UTIL.CSV_FILE_FORMAT') PATTERN = '.*orders.*\.csv'
orders_pipe.comment: Snowpipe for automatic orders CSV data ingestion from S3
